notes: Explore idea: spc-control-charts, a free Shewhart control chart tool (I-MR, X-bar R/S, averages as individuals, p, np, c, u) with the eight Nelson rules, Phase I exclusion/revision, a between-subgroup ratio check, and Cp/Cpk/Pp/Ppk with Bissell's bound. Constants d2/d3/c4 computed by numerical integration/gamma and matched to published tables n=2..25 plus a 200k-subgroup simulation. Real example: NIST/SEMATECH LITHOGRA.DAT (public domain): X-bar R flags 25/90 wafers; averages as individuals flags only cassette 27's three wafers (between/within ratio 1.9). Bench (20,000 stable processes, seed 2026): any-signal rate 15.4%/28.6% (X-bar R 25x5, rule 1 / all eight), 62.5%/84.4% (I-MR 100 points), MR chart alone 57.5% vs I chart 23.4%. Local checks: node --test 32/32; Chromium smoke 380/1100 px, no console errors, no overflow. Local workflows (run_workflow_locally --for-changes): 9 workflows' run: steps passed; pages/portfolio-pages site build skipped (needs ${{ }}), so CI is the verdict there. First CI round failed two real checks: check_csv_formula_guard (export had no formula-injection guard; added, with a test) and siblings.mjs --check (new page had no sibling linking it; cross-linked with changepoint-detector, whose suite passes 33/33 locally). spc suite 33/33 after the fix.
